# KeyHome — Plateforme Immobilière Afrique Francophone
# https://keyhome.app
# Version: 1.0 | Updated: 2026-05

## About
KeyHome is a real estate marketplace for francophone sub-Saharan Africa.
All listings are manually verified by the team. Micro-payment model for contact unlock.
Currency: XAF/XOF (CFA Franc). Language: French (fr_FR).

## Coverage
Active markets: Cameroon (Douala, Yaoundé, Bafoussam), Benin (Cotonou),
Togo (Lomé), Côte d'Ivoire (Abidjan), Ghana (Accra), Mali (Bamako), Senegal (Dakar).

## Product
- Free registration for tenants and landlords
- Verified listings: photos, price, owner identity checked manually
- Contact unlock via Mobile Money (MTN, Orange, Moov, Wave) or card (Visa, Mastercard)
- Owner dashboard with analytics, lease management, visit scheduling
- 3D virtual tours on selected listings

## API
Public listing API (read-only, no auth required):
  GET https://keyhome.app/api/v1/ads — paginated listing index
  GET https://keyhome.app/api/v1/ads/{slug} — listing detail
